proposed_text: JIBC ESS Quick Reference Guide (2012; from PHAC Emergency Lodging Service 2007): group lodging 3.5 m² minimum sleeping area per person; City of Edmonton Minimum Emergency Shelter Standards (2021) s.4: 2 m between beds in congregate settings; Health Canada, Guidance for Cleaner Air Spaces during Wildfire Smoke Events (2020): MERV 13+ filters, portable air cleaners sized for 2–3 room volumes per hour (Formulas sheet)
note: All three sources are named and confirmed. Health Canada does not use the term 'ACH'. The 3.5 m² is a 2012 JIBC guide, not a current BC ESS standard; whether a newer BC ESS document repeats it was not checked.
